card.fact_statement: The Office of the Inspector General of Colombia reported that around 46,000 children were unable to begin the academic year due to the violence.
card.answer: Office of the Inspector General of Colombia
card.source_span: The Office of the Inspector General of Colombia reported that around 46,000 children have not been able to begin the academic year due to the violence
